nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of Co(OH)2
nodes.procedure: 0.582 g of Co(NO3)2·6H2O and 0.56 g of hexamethylenetetramine (HMT) were dissolved in 15 mL of distilled water under vigorous stirring to form a clear solution and then, the solution was transferred into a 20 mL Teflon-lined stainlesssteel autoclave. The autoclave was placed in an electric oven at 100 °C for 10 h. After cooling to room temperature naturally, Co(OH)2 nanosheets were collected by centrifugation, thorough washing with water/ethanol alternatively and drying under vacuum.
nodes.source_text: Typically, 0.582 g of Co(NO3)2·6H2O and 0.56 g of hexamethylenetetramine (HMT) were dissolved in 15 mL of distilled water... drying under vacuum.

nodes.name: Phosphorization to CoP
nodes.procedure: To prepare CoP nanosheets, Co(OH)2 nanosheets (100 mg) and NaH2PO2·H2O (2 g) were put at two separate positions in a quartz boat with NaH2PO2 at the upstream side of the furnace. Subsequently, the temperature of the tube furnace was increased to 300 °C with a ramp rate of 5 °C min⁻¹ maintained at 300 °C for 60 min, and then naturally cooled to room temperature under the protection of Ar with a flow rate of 100 mL min⁻¹.
nodes.source_text: To prepare CoP nanosheets, Co(OH)2 nanosheets (100 mg) and NaH2PO2·H2O (2 g) were put... under the protection of Ar with a flow rate of 100 mL min⁻¹.

nodes.name: EG reduction Pt loading
nodes.procedure: 50 mg of CoP was suspended in 50 mL of ethylene glycol. Then, 150 μL of H2PtCl6 aqueous solutions (Pt content = 5 mg mL⁻¹) were added to the above CoP suspensions to reach the theoretical Pt loading of 1.5 wt%. The mixtures were treated at 150 °C for 3 h in Ar atmosphere. Subsequently, the suspensions were filtered and washed with water/ethanol thoroughly and then dried at 60 °C for 12 h under vacuum to obtain the EG-Pt/CoP catalysts.

nodes.name: NaBH4 reduction Pt loading
nodes.procedure: 50 mg of CoP was suspended in 47 mL of distilled water, and then, 150 μL of H2PtCl6 solutions (Pt content = 5 mg mL⁻¹) were added to achieve the theoretical Pt loading of 1.5 wt%. After stirring at room temperature for 3 h, 3 mL of the freshly prepared NaBH4 aqueous solution (containing 95 mg NaBH4) was quickly added under vigorous stirring. After 3 h reaction under the stirring, the products were centrifuged, washed with water/ethanol thoroughly, and then dried at 60 °C for 12 h under vacuum to obtain the Pt/CoP catalysts.

nodes.characterization_summary: Infrared spectra show characteristic peaks of EG, confirming its presence in hybrid catalysts.

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution XPS spectra detect typical signals of CoP, metallic Pt and PtOx species.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the high-resolution XPS spectra (Fig. S8, ESI†) of EG-Pt/CoP, we can also detect the typical signals of CoP, metallic Pt and PtOx species, supporting the formation of EG-Pt/CoP hybrids.
